briefs.r030_0: Check length, format, venue timing, prior acceptance age, pair limits, Track D endorsements, retraction status, figure count, padding rule, and withdrawal reset; then assign HANDLED, RETURNED or PADDED.
briefs.r030_1: Apply each rule in order; if any mandatory rule fails, RETURNED. Only when only R9 low‑figure failure occurs, output PADDED. Otherwise, when all applicable rules pass, HANDLED.
briefs.r030_2: ≥22 pages; template or ≥3‑year revision history (Track D: two endorsements). Venue >18 months ago, no acceptance <5 years. ≤45 figures (pad if <8). Paired: both meet length/format; one meets venue. Retracted → reject.
briefs.r030_3: Check each manuscript against every rule in order; if any rule disqualifies it (except R9’s padding case), mark RETURNED. Only when all applicable rules pass, output HANDLED or PADDED per R9.
briefs.r070_0: Read each rule in order; stop at the first one that forces a decision. If R7 applies, verdict is RETURNED regardless of everything else. Otherwise test R1–R6 (and R10 where relevant). For paired submissions treat them as two independent papers for R1‑R2, require at least one to meet R3, and apply figure limits per R8‑R9. After all applicable rules pass, answer HANDLED; if only the low‑figure case applies, answer PADDED.
briefs.r070_1: Check every manuscript against the list in order. First confirm length (R1) then format or revision history (R2), unless it is a Track D paper which instead needs exactly two endorsements (R6). Verify venue timing (R3) and prior‑round age (R4); withdrawals reset the R3 clock (R10). For paired submissions ensure both meet R1/R2 and at least one meets R3 (R5). Apply figure limits (R8‑R9) and reject any with an open retraction (R7). Finally assign HANDLED, PADDED or RETURNED.
briefs.r070_2: Check each manuscript: verify ≥22 pages (R1) and either use the template or show three‑year revision history (R2), unless Track D, where two endorsements replace R2. Ensure figure count 8–45 (up to 70 for paired); pad if below minimum, return if above maximum (R8‑R9). Reject any with an open retraction (R7). Require venue presentations >18 months before deadline and prior acceptances ≥5 years (R3‑R4). Paired submissions must meet R1‑R2 individually, and at least one satisfies the venue rule.
briefs.r070_3: Read each rule in order; if any rule declares RETURNED, stop and mark RETURNED. Only when all applicable rules are satisfied do you assign HANDLED. The sole exception is R9: if a submission fails only by having too few figures, label it PADDED instead of RETURNED. Remember that paired submissions must meet both manuscripts’ R1/R2, at least one meets R3, and Track D replaces R2 with exactly two endorsements.
briefs.r110_0:
Apply the rules sequentially; the first that decides the outcome stops further checks.

1. Open retraction notice → RETURNED (R7 overrides all).  
2. Pages < 22 → RETURNED (R1).  
3. Not using official template and lacking ≥3 years revision history → RETURNED unless Track D (R2).  
4. Track D submissions must have exactly two endorsements; otherwise RETURNED (R6).  
5. Tier‑1 venue presentation ≤18 months before deadline → RETURNED (R3).  
6. Prior acceptance <5 years ago → RETURNED (R4).  
7. Paired submission: exactly two papers, each passing R1 and R2, and at least one passes R3; otherwise RETURNED (R5).  
8. Figure count: if below 8, pad to eight and mark PADDED (R9); if above max (45 single, 70 paired) → RETURNED.

If none of these apply, verdict is HANDLED.
briefs.r110_1: Read the rules in this order. First check R7; any open retraction makes the manuscript RETURNED immediately, ignoring every other rule. Next verify length (R1) and format (R2), except when the paper is submitted to Track D, where R2 is replaced by exactly two endorsements (R6). Apply venue timing (R3), remembering that a withdrawal resets the presentation date (R10). If the manuscript was accepted in a previous round, enforce the five‑year gap (R4). For paired submissions confirm both items meet R1 and R2, at least one satisfies R3, and figure limits follow R8; excess figures cause RETURNED, while too few trigger PADDED (R9). Finally, if all applicable rules pass, mark HANDLED.
briefs.r110_2: Read each submission in this order. First check R7; any open retraction is RETURNED immediately. Then verify length (R1) – at least 22 pages, exactly 22 counts. Confirm format (R2) unless the paper is submitted to Track D (R6), where two endorsements replace the template/history requirement. Apply venue timing (R3): a Tier‑1 presentation must be more than 18 months before 1 Mar 2026; if a withdrawal occurred, treat the presentation date as the withdrawal date (R10). Examine prior‑round acceptance (R4); fewer than five years disqualifies. For paired submissions enforce R5 and figure limits (R8). If figures are below the minimum, pad (R9) unless they exceed the maximum, which returns.
briefs.r110_3: To decide a manuscript’s verdict follow these steps. First check R7: an retraction makes it RETURNED. Verify length (R1)—at least 22 pages; otherwise RETURNED. Assess format (R2); if not using the template, three years of revision history are needed unless in Track D (R6), which requires two endorsements. Check venue overlap (R3): a Tier‑1 presentation is allowed only if it occurred more than 18 months before the deadline; withdrawals reset this clock (R10). Apply prior‑round rule (R4): acceptances within five years are rejected. For paired submissions ensure they satisfy R1,R2, two papers, and at least one satisfies R3 (R5). Count figures (R8); if below eight pad to eight and label PADDED (R9), but any excess above the maximum returns RETURNED. If all applicable rules pass, output HANDLED.
briefs.r150_0:
Apply the checklist in order; stop at the first failure unless a later rule explicitly overrides it.

1. Length – ≥22 pages (exactly 22 counts).
2. Format – official template **or** ≥3 years documented revision history.
3. Tier‑1 venue – presentation must be >18 months before 1 Mar 2026; exactly 18 fails.
4. Prior acceptance – at least 5 years since any earlier Meridian acceptance; withdrawals are not acceptances.
5. Paired submission – exactly two manuscripts, each meeting rules 1 and 2; at least one must also satisfy rule 3. No larger groups.
6. Track D – skips rule 2 but requires exactly two endorsements; all other rules apply.
7. Retraction – any open retraction forces RETURNED, overriding everything.
8‑9. Figures – 8–45 figures (70 for a pair). If below 8, pad to eight → PADDED; if above max, RETURNED.
10. Withdrawals – reset the venue clock to the withdrawal date.

Finally, output HANDLED, RETURNED, or PADDED as the sole verdict.
briefs.r150_1:
Use this checklist for each submission as of 1 Mar 2026.

1. Length – ≥22 pages (exactly 22 counts).
2. Format – either the official template OR at least three years of documented revision history.
3. Venue overlap – if presented at a Tier‑1 venue, the presentation must be >18 months before the deadline; exactly 18 months fails.
4. Prior round – an earlier Meridian acceptance is disallowed unless ≥5 years have passed; withdrawals do not count as acceptances and reset the venue clock to the withdrawal date.
5. Paired submission – allowed only for exactly two manuscripts. Each must meet R1 and R2; at least one of them must also satisfy R3. No other numbers are permitted.
6. Track D – replaces R2 with a requirement for exactly two endorsements; all other rules still apply.
7. Retraction – any open retraction automatically yields RETURNED, overriding every rule.
8. Figures – total must be 8‑45 inclusive (70 max for a pair).

If figures are below the minimum, pad to 8 and label PADDED; excess figures cause RETURNED. A submission meeting all applicable checks is HANDLED.
briefs.r150_2:
Follow this ordered checklist.

1. R7 – If an open retraction notice is present, verdict = RETURNED; stop.  
2. R1 – Pages ≥ 22 (exactly 22 counts). Fail → RETURNED.  
3. R2 – Use official template **or** have ≥3 years revision history. For Track‑D papers skip R2 and require exactly two endorsements (R6); any other number → RETURNED.  
4. R3 – Tier‑1 presentation must be >18 months before 1 Mar 2026. In a paired set, at least one manuscript must meet this.  
5. R4 – If accepted in a prior round <5 years ago, verdict = RETURNED.  
6. R5 – Paired submissions allowed only as exactly two manuscripts; each must satisfy R1 and R2, and only one needs to satisfy R3.  
7. R8/R9 – Figure count 8‑45 (up to 70 for a pair). Below 8 → pad to eight, verdict = PADDED. Above maximum → RETURNED.

If none of the above cause a return or padding, the manuscript is HANDLED.
briefs.r150_3:
Use this checklist in order; stop at the first rule that makes the submission fail.

1. Length – manuscript must have ≥22 pages (22 counts).  
2. Format – either use the official template **or** include documented revision history covering at least three years.  
3. Venue overlap – if presented at a Tier‑1 venue, the presentation date must be >18 months before 1 Mar 2026; exactly 18 months fails.  
4. Prior round – an earlier Meridian acceptance is disallowed unless ≥5 years have passed since that round. Withdrawals do not count as acceptances and reset the venue clock (treat the withdrawal date as the presentation date).  
5. Paired submission – allowed for exactly two manuscripts; each must meet R1 and R2, and at least one of the pair must satisfy R3.  
6. Track D – exempts only R2; instead supply exactly two endorsements.  
7. Retraction – any open retraction causes automatic RETURN regardless of other rules.  
8. Figures – total must be 8‑45 inclusive (70 allowed for a pair).  
9. If figure count is below the minimum, pad to 8 and issue PADDED; excess figures cause RETURN.

Result: HANDLED if no rule fails, otherwise RETURNED or PADDED as specified.
